description: This source file defines the AttractionListFragment class, which is a Fragment used in an Android application to display a list of tourist attractions sorted by distance from the user's current location. It manages attraction data loading, location updates, and user interactions within the attraction list.

classes.name: AttractionListFragment
classes.description: Main fragment class that displays the list of attractions sorted by proximity, updating location data, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: AttractionAdapter
classes.description: Inner RecyclerView.Adapter class managing the display of attraction items in the list.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: Static inner class that holds references to views for each list item, implementing click handling.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes the list adapter and recycler view, sets initial data based on current location.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers location update broadcast receiver when the fragment becomes active.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters location update broadcast receiver when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: mBroadcastReceiver.onReceive
methods.description: Handles location change broadcasts by updating the current location and refreshes the list.

methods.name: loadAttractionsFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and sorts attractions based on proximity to the provided location.

methods.name: AttractionAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new view holders for the list items.

methods.name: AttractionAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds attraction data to view holder views, including image loading with Glide and distance display.

methods.name: AttractionAdapter.onItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on attraction items, launching detailed activity.

methods.name: ViewHolder.onClick
methods.description: Delegates click events to item click listener.
